# Translation Assistant
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns translation into an AI workflow: the model drafts, you direct.
Text, files, screenshots, and whole folders are translated by AI; your glossary and style rules ride
along on every request; every score and comment you leave becomes the instruction for an AI rewrite
; and each pass keeps a rollback point. The job shifts from typing translations to judging them.
中文
**What the AI workflow changes**
| Before | With Translation Assistant |
| Type every segment; look terms up as you go | AI drafts the full text in one pass — a `.translatio

n-spec/` glossary and style rules are attached to every request automatically |
| Mark problems, the
n retype the fixes | Score a segment and write one comment; `Apply suggestion` turns both into the r

ewrite instruction for that segment |
| Copy-paste files into a translator tab, one at a time | Poin
t the workspace at a folder: batch translation walks every pending file and writes the results back

to disk while you review what has landed |
| One model has to do everything | One model translates,
another reviews: the draft comes from a fast model, and a stronger one scores it and rewrites from i

ts own comments |
| Switch windows to translate a snippet from chat | The same engine is an Agent to
ol — the assistant translates and reviews inside the conversation |
**Highlights**
- **AI at every step** — drafting, retranslating with your prompt, scoring, rewriting from your comm
ents, and reading text out of screenshots are all model calls; the plugin orchestrates them into one

loop.
- **Review instead of retyping** — the side-by-side view shows the draft; you touch only the

segments that need it, and AI applies your notes to the rest.
[该节后续省略]
## Install
One line from a terminal:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or from the GUI: **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter `dsh-translation-assistant`, press **Install**, the
**Plugins → Add plugin**, enter `dsh-translation-assistant`, press **Install**, then **Enable now**.
Local checkout, Git address, manual registry, and upgrading or uninstalling: docs/install.md.
## What you get
### Translate
- `By paragraph` or `By sentence`, both returned in one pass; speed-first mode runs chunks concurren

tly and shows a `Translating n/m` counter.
- Three AI translation modes, picked on the new-translati
on form and in the full-text card. When a response does not match the chosen protocol, the pass fall
s back to batching without raising an error.
| Mode | Trait | Best for |
| Coherence first | One request for the full text, the fullest context | Essays, reports — the defau

lt |
| Alignment first | JSON-array protocol, the strongest paragraph alignment | Glossaries, subtit

les, strict side-by-side layouts |
| Speed first | Chunked three-way concurrency, fastest on long te
xts | Time-boxed bulk jobs |
- **Files** — drop or pick `.txt`, `.md`, `.log`, `.html`, `.htm`, `.docx` (Word files are unpacked

in the browser; the original never leaves the machine).
- **Images** — paste or pick a screenshot; A
I transcribes it, then translates.
### Workspace
- Workspaces are the projects you already added in Harness: a picker at the top of the drawer lists
every project folder, selection switches instantly, and the last one is remembered. Reads and writes

stay confined to the selected project; the drawer never covers what you are proofreading.
- When th
e host does not expose the project list (e.g. `dsh web`), a collapsible manual path entry serves as

the fallback; an outdated Host side (404) points to a Harness restart.
- The tree folds by folder; c
licking a file name opens it — untranslated files start translating immediately, translated ones reo

pen for proofreading.
- Output goes to a `translated/` subfolder (default), a suffixed sibling copy,
over the original, or stays on the page only without touching disk; `.docx` translations always sav

e as `.md`. Proofread edits can auto-save or wait for the save button.
- `Translate all` walks the p
ending files in order and saves each result; a stop ends the run after the file in flight. While wor

kspace content is open, the workspace button shows the project's name.
- A `.translation-spec/` fold
er in the workspace holds guideline documents (`glossary.md`, `style.md`, …) that ride along on ever
y AI pass; the drawer can view, edit, create, and delete them, and the banner shows which guidelines
he drawer can view, edit, create, and delete them, and the banner shows which guidelines are active.
### Review and refine
- Source and translation sit side by side; every segment is editable, and edits re-join sentences an

d paragraphs correctly.
[该节后续省略]
### Keep track

- On-device history — up to 200 documents with search, pinning, and two-click deletion.
[该节后续省略]
## How it works
`host/index.js` registers a same-origin `/dsh-translation/api` route and the Agent tool, `host/engin
e.js` does the model work (no Harness imports), and `client.js` is the page. POSTs are origin-checke
d and capped at 24 MiB, and every request can pin a `route: { provider, model }`.
Endpoints, configuration fields, on-device storage, the full limits, and maintainer notes: docs/refe
, configuration fields, on-device storage, the full limits, and maintainer notes: docs/reference.md.
## Privacy
History, edits, and preferences never leave the browser; only the text being translated, retranslate
d, scored, or read from an image is sent to the model route. Clearing site data for the Harness orig
in erases the history — there is no server-side copy.
